ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms flag names, a rollback owner and the permanent-unowned flag are declared; it does not read live flag state.
offer: Give feature flags an owner and a rollback route. Unowned permanent flags accumulate untested branches and should not pass as deliberate release controls.

minimal.reason: List the feature flags in use. Unlisted flags accumulate untested branches, so name each one.

mid.reason: Name who can roll each flag back. A flag without an owner cannot be turned off in an incident, so assign one.

maximal.reason: Set permanent unowned flags to false. Flags that outlive their purpose are dead branches, so remove them or assign an owner.
